## Problem

<!-- What is wrong, observed where. Numbered facts, not narrative. -->

<!-- One bullet per file or mechanism: what it does now, and the one

## Before / after

<!-- Only for behavior changes an operator can see. Real captured

## Verification

<!-- What actually ran, not what was read: RED/GREEN evidence, suite,
vet, CI, reviewer verdicts, live validation on the target host or an
explicit statement of what is NOT covered. -->

## Follow-up

<!-- What this PR deliberately does not do, and where that work lands
